structures.overall_structure: Grayscale micrograph of IN939 nickel-based superalloy whose main focus is the melted pool boundary; the field is dominated by large elongated lenticular/plate-shaped features separated by thin boundaries, and the extracted key-structure binary shows a thin white boundary skeleton with black interiors.

interfaces.interface_notes: The melted pool boundary is the main focus of the IN939-1 micrograph; MatSAM reasonably recognizes and clearly separates the melted pool boundaries.

characterization_methods.technique: Microstructure image segmentation using MatSAM (training-free visual large model)
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: MatSAM, built on the Segment Anything Model (SAM)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Grayscale micrograph; no corresponding annotations provided
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify and extract the melted pool boundary in the IN939-1 nickel-based superalloy micrograph
characterization_methods.key_findings: The melted pool boundaries are reasonably recognized and clearly separated; the extracted key-structure binary shows a thin white boundary skeleton with black interiors.

computational_details.simulation_method: Training-free microstructure segmentation by MatSAM (SAM-based visual large model)
computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: Structure-aware prompt points (ROI points merged with grid points) generated automatically guide the segmentation
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: No annotations available for IN939-1; segmentation quality assessed qualitatively via visual inspection of the overlay and key-structure binary.

unmapped_findings: IN939-1 is one of six additional micrographs used in the extended experiments demonstrating MatSAM's extensibility/generalizability; these image samples were not provided with corresponding annotations.

The IN939-1 micrograph is grayscale and shows the melted pool boundary as large elongated lenticular/plate-shaped features separated by thin boundaries; the binary output reduces the melted pool boundary to a thin white boundary skeleton.
